newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras still a buy.

text.p: -- ING Barings said in a report that it maintained its buy rating for Brazilian state-owned telecom company Telebras.
-- It set a new target price for Telebras at between $130 to $150 per ADR.
-- "Currently Telebras is the cheapest stock in our Latin telecom universe," it added.
-- ING Barings expects Telebras' profitability to surge due to rate restructuring and heavy line growth, coupled with workforce cutting and streamlining.
It said the company will be able to expand dividend payments in 1998 as aresult of "huge free cash flow appearing in 1997".
Telebras preferred shares were trading at 100.90 reais, up 3.49 percent.
